name: 约兰达
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:853
who: Yolanda, a human girl of sixteen from the back alleys of the lower city, the youngest sword-for-hire of the Night-Slayers company: about 163 cm, a slender, long-legged, light-footed frame built for running wet rooftops, wholly covered by her clothes. Apricot-red short hair she cuts herself with scissors, ragged and uneven at the ends. Clear teal-green eyes. A thin pale scar runs straight across the bridge of her nose. A faded, washed-out red headscarf is always on her. No earrings, no other jewellery. A quick, sharp, warm-hearted air: a street kid who sticks up for the alley and is cleverer than she lets on.
palette: apricot red, teal green, ash grey, charcoal, faded red
casual: Her Night-Slayer clothes: the company's grey short cloak to the hip, the hood down, fastened at the throat; under it a fitted charcoal long-sleeved tunic, a plain leather belt, dark trousers tucked into soft, thin-soled roof-running boots wrapped at the ankle with leather thongs; the faded red headscarf knotted around her left wrist (on the viewer's right when she faces us); an old plain straight sword in a worn scabbard at her left hip. She stands loose and ready, the weight on one foot, a cocky closed-mouth grin.
private: Off duty in the company's attic: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt, a knitted grey wool shawl around the shoulders, dark wool trousers, thick wool socks and the boots unlaced; the faded red headscarf on her left wrist (on the viewer's right when she faces us). She stands with a heel of bread in one hand, a relaxed closed-mouth smile.
battle: On the rooftops at night: the grey short cloak pulled tight with the hood up, the faded red headscarf now tied over her nose and mouth as a mask so only the teal-green eyes show, both wrists bare; leather bracers over the sleeves, the charcoal tunic and dark trousers, the soft roof boots. She holds the old plain straight sword low and forward in her right hand, a straight double-edged blade, NOT a curved sword; the empty worn scabbard at her left hip; a low, light ready stance on the balls of her feet, the eyes sharp.
formal: Her one good set for a feast night at the tavern: a clean undyed linen shirt buttoned to the collar with long sleeves, a fitted dark russet wool waistcoat, a long dark grey wool skirt to the ankles over her boots, the grey short cloak brushed clean, the faded red headscarf freshly washed and tied on her left wrist (on the viewer's right when she faces us). She stands a little stiffly, the hands behind her back, a shy closed-mouth smile.
art: A chest-up portrait, the camera tilted, her face large and off-centre, the teal-green eyes fully open and fixed on the viewer, the mouth closed, a serious, alert look. Cold blue night light falls from one side while warm lamplight from a window below rims her apricot-red hair. Foreground blur: rain-wet roof tiles, drifting raindrops and the loose end of the faded red headscarf. She wears the grey short cloak.

name: 尼克尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:909
who: Nickel, a human boy of fourteen, a locksmith's apprentice from the lower city who listens to locks: about 158 cm, short, light and thin with long arms, wholly covered by his clothes. Sandy hair tangled like a bird's nest. Amber eyes, the left one (on the viewer's right when he faces us) always a little narrower than the other from years of squinting into keyholes. A small corner chipped off one front tooth. Around his neck on a leather cord hangs a small brass key that opens nothing, the first key he ever made. No glasses, no earrings. A quiet, precise, stubborn boy who counts everything.
palette: sandy blond, amber, worn brown leather, faded blue-grey, brass
casual: His workshop clothes: a locksmith's brown leather apron over a long-sleeved faded blue-grey linen shirt buttoned at the wrists, a row of narrow pockets across the apron's chest holding thin steel picks and tiny files; a coil of hemp rope wound around his waist with a small iron grappling hook knotted at the rope's end; dark brown trousers and worn boots; the brass key on its cord at his neck. A thin steel pick held between his teeth, the head tilted as if listening.
private: At home in the back room of the lock shop: a long-sleeved, loose brown knitted wool jumper over a linen shirt, dark trousers, thick socks and worn boots, the brass key at his neck. He stands holding a half-filed key in one hand and a small file in the other, studying it with one eye narrowed.
battle: Out on a night job with his master: a dark grey hooded short cloak over the long-sleeved shirt, a snug dark leather tool vest with narrow pockets of picks in place of the apron, dark trousers and soft-soled boots; the hemp rope with its small iron hook coiled over his right shoulder instead of round his waist; the brass key tucked inside his collar. He holds a thin steel pick ready.
battle_pose: 3) the night-job outfit: alert and focused, the shoulders hunched a little forward, the feet planted, one hand gripping the iron hook on its rope and the other holding a thin steel pick; he is a lock apprentice and holds no weapon.
formal: His one best set for a holiday: a clean long-sleeved white linen shirt buttoned to the collar, a dark blue wool waistcoat with brass buttons, neat brown wool trousers and polished old boots, the sandy hair wetted down but still sticking up, the brass key on a fresh cord at his neck. He stands stiffly with the hands at his sides, a solemn closed mouth.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the camera tilted, his face large, the amber eyes open and looking straight at the viewer, the mouth closed, a solemn, wary look. Warm lamp-amber light from one side catches his messy sandy hair. Foreground blur: thin steel picks, the teeth of a brass key and the curve of an iron lock. The collar of the leather apron and the shirt cover the shoulders.

name: 列纳特·兰策
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:2022
who: Lennart Lanze, a human young man of eighteen from a soldier-household village at the foot of the southern Long Rampart, now a guide leading refugees through the reed marshes: 181 cm, tall and lean with long legs, the shoulders not yet filled out. Messy wheat-straw gold hair, a small tuft at the back tied with a bit of reed cord. Bright sky-blue eyes that light up when he talks. A faint pale scar runs across the bridge of his nose. Around his neck hangs a small brass sentry whistle from the wall's changing of the guard, which he never blows. No earrings, no other jewellery. A chatty, quick, warm air: a joker who goes quiet and direct when it counts.
build: 181 cm, tall and lean: long legs, narrow shoulders still filling out, a light, wiry frame.
palette: wheat gold, sky blue, worn leather brown, reed green, polished old iron
casual: His guide's clothes: an old soldier-household sleeveless leather jerkin, scuffed and mended, over a long-sleeved undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm; a bundle of sharpened reed darts tucked at his belt on the left hip; mud-stained brown trousers tucked into high marsh boots; slung diagonally across his back a sawn-off half spear, the ash shaft cut down to chest height and roughly sawn at the end, the head of old wall iron polished bright; the brass whistle at his neck. A lopsided, chatty grin, one hand pointing the way.
private: At the fire circle at night: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt untucked, an old grey wool scarf, the brown trousers rolled to the shin, barefoot with the boots off, the brass whistle at his neck. He stands holding a wooden ladle, a tired, easy smile.
battle: Holding the ford at night, in old war gear refitted for the marsh: a dark enchanted scale vest from the wall armouries, its small plates re-laced and lit by a faint blue-white rune line down each edge, worn over his shirt; a single articulated enchanted pauldron on the right shoulder with an empty crystal socket and one lit crystal; rune-etched steel vambraces; a short faded grey-brown cloak thrown back over the shoulders, its hem stitched with a glowing ward thread; a bandolier of reed darts whose tips glint with spell-light. He grips the sawn-off half spear in both hands, the polished old iron head forward, a thin line of flame running along the blade edge. The feet set wide, the grin gone, the jaw set.
formal: The soldier-household wall dress he never swore in: a grey-brown wool garrison coat buttoned straight to the collar over an old chain-mail shirt, a broad leather belt, clean brown trousers and blacked boots, the brass whistle polished and hanging outside the coat, the gold hair combed back with the little reed-cord tuft. He stands at attention, a rare serious face.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his face large and off-centre, the sky-blue eyes looking at the viewer, mid-word, with a quick crooked grin. Low orange firelight from below and one side lights his messy wheat-gold hair, the night behind in deep reed green. Foreground blur: swaying reed fronds, drifting sparks and the polished iron edge of the half spear. The brass whistle glints at his throat.
battle_old: Holding the ford at night: the leather jerkin laced tight, leather bracers, a short faded grey-brown cloak thrown back over the shoulders; he grips the sawn-off half spear in both hands, the polished old iron head forward, a thin line of flame running along the blade edge; the reed darts at his belt; the feet set wide, the grin gone, the jaw set.

name: 伊洛温
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:待补（材料里这一条截断，没有行号）
who: Ilowen, a wood elf of the Watchers who came back to the Wall, nearly three hundred years old and still looking eighteen or nineteen: 174 cm, long-limbed and supple. Soft platinum-blonde curly hair to the shoulder blades, a small plain wooden comb set in it. Garnet-red eyes. Long pointed elf ears. An old pale arrow scar across her right cheek (on the viewer's left when she faces us). She carries a pale wooden longbow. No earrings, no other jewellery. Gentle and unhurried, she asks before she touches anything, like a neighbour borrowing a needle; steady hands on the bowstring.
build: 174 cm, long-limbed with supple shoulders and neck: a D-cup, a narrow waist and rounded hips.
palette: platinum blonde, garnet red, moss green, white thread, pale birch wood
casual: Her everyday clothes: a long moss-green wool dress to mid-calf with long fitted sleeves, closing down the front with wooden buttons, mended here and there with neat white-thread patches; a plain leather belt with a small sewing pouch; thick hand-knitted undyed wool stockings darned with white thread; soft brown leather ankle boots. She holds an unstrung pale wooden longbow in one hand, a soft, patient half-smile.
private: At the window of the Sten house: a long-sleeved undyed linen dress, a knitted grey shawl around the shoulders, the hand-knitted stockings and soft slippers, the wooden comb in her hair. She stands holding an old knitted stocking and a needle threaded with white thread, taking in its cuff.
battle: Holding the breach in the Wall: a short moss-green hooded cloak over a fitted dark green leather jerkin, the long dress kilted up over brown leather leggings, a leather bracer on the left forearm (on the viewer's right when she faces us), a quiver of arrows on her back; she draws the pale wooden longbow with an arrow nocked, faint glowing white tree-like veins running along her hands and forearms; the feet planted.
formal: At the rededication of the Return-to-the-Forest stone: a long ivory-white linen gown with long sleeves and a high round neckline, under a moss-green over-tunic embroidered at the hem with small white leaves, a narrow belt of plaited white cord, the wooden comb in her hair with a sprig of white blossom. She stands with the hands folded in front, a quiet, grave smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, her face large and off-centre, the garnet-red eyes looking at the viewer with a gentle, patient, asking look. Warm golden light filters through leaves from one side onto her platinum curls and the wooden comb. Foreground blur: small white leaves, pale roots and drifting white petals. She wears the moss-green dress with its white-thread patches.

name: 柯斯瑟
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:待补（同伊洛温那一条）
who: Kosser, a lizardfolk of the East Spring in the southern marshes, a hundred years old yet still in the prime of life: 193 cm, a heavy, broad-backed reptilian warrior with a thick, weighty tail. Grey-green scales darkening to deep teal along the back, golden-brown eyes with vertical slit pupils, a row of fin-spines on each side of the head shaped like old spearheads. A patch of missing scales on the right side of the lower jaw (on the viewer's left when he faces us), an old mark from a quarrel over fish, not a battle scar. He always carries a bone spear whose shaft is wrapped neatly and handsomely in faded red woven reed-cloth. No jewellery. Slow-spoken, patient, steady as a post.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lizardfolk's long reptilian head, NOT a human face: a blunt scaled snout, a wide lipless mouth closed over small teeth, nostril slits, golden-brown eyes with vertical slit pupils under heavy scaled brow ridges, grey-green scales across the face, the spearhead-shaped fin-spines swept back from both sides of the head, the bare patch on the right side of the lower jaw (on the viewer's left when he faces us); a calm, weathered, steady look.
build: 193 cm, burly: a deep chest, broad thick shoulders and back, heavy arms, strong legs and a thick, heavy tail.
palette: grey-green and deep teal scales, golden brown, faded red, dry reed straw, bone white
casual: His everyday clothes at the springs: a knee-length wrap kilt of woven dry reed over dark green linen, a broad leather belt with a bone buckle, a short woven-reed mantle over the left shoulder (on the viewer's right when he faces us) fastened with a bone pin, leather wraps on the forearms, barefoot on clawed feet. He holds the bone spear upright at his side, its shaft wrapped in faded red reed-cloth.
private: At rest between the two spring circles: a long loose undyed linen tunic to the knees with short wide sleeves, a reed-woven apron tied over it, barefoot. He stands holding a mended wooden bucket in one hand, a slow, mild look.
battle: Standing outside the weapon circle: a hardened leather cuirass set with bone plates over the reed kilt, layered bone pauldrons, leather forearm guards; he grips the bone spear in both hands, its red-wrapped shaft lit by a faint blue-green glow that runs up his spine and along the shaft; the feet planted wide, the tail braced behind him.
formal: At the shared feast of the two springs: a long dark teal linen tunic to the shins, closing down the front with bone toggles, fitted sleeves, a broad sash of faded red woven reed-cloth around the waist, a collar of small polished river shells, the forearm wraps fresh. He stands very upright, the hands folded in front, a grave, gentle look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his reptilian head large and off-centre, the golden slit-pupilled eyes looking at the viewer, calm and unmoving. A cold blue-green glow rises from below and one side along the fin-spines. Foreground blur: reed fronds, splashing marsh water and the faded red cloth wrapped on the bone spear.

name: 贝特拉姆·阿姆特曼
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3114
who: Bertram Amtmann, a human steward of the Wachter house, keeper of the accounts and of the banner vault at Eagle-stone on the northern Wall, forty years old: tall and lean, very straight-backed. Pale flaxen-yellow hair combed flat back against the skull. Very deep blue eyes that look first at the calluses on people's hands. A heavy ring of brass vault keys always on his belt. No glasses, no rings, no earrings. Polite and unhurried, a clerk's voice that always has a number in it, and cold under the courtesy.
build: about 183 cm, tall and lean with a very straight back, narrow shoulders and long, clean hands.
palette: slate grey, deep blue, pale flaxen yellow, brass, black
casual: His steward's clothes: a long dark slate-grey wool coat closing down the front with small brass buttons, fitted sleeves with black cloth oversleeves, a high white shirt collar, a small enamel badge of the Wachter house pinned at the chest, a grey watchtower on a wall; dark trousers and polished black boots; the ring of brass vault keys at his right hip. He holds a thick leather-bound muster ledger against his chest, a polite, thin smile.
private: In the counting room after hours: the coat off, a long-sleeved white shirt buttoned to the collar under a dark grey wool waistcoat, the black oversleeves still on, the brass keys at his hip. He stands holding a quill pen and a loose page of figures, reading it with a faint frown.
battle: Out on the snow line: a heavy wolf-skin coat worn fur inside, the outside tanned pale, over an iron scale shirt, fur-lined gloves, tall boots; the brass keys at his hip. He holds upright a tall pole carrying an old, faded, tattered war banner of the Wall's northern legions, the pole's iron-shod tip serving as his spear; standing straight and composed.
formal: At the Wachter house's audience day: a black wool frock coat to the knee closing down the front with silver buttons, a dove-grey waistcoat, a white neckcloth, the house badge, white gloves, polished boots, the brass keys polished at his hip. He stands with a slight bow, the ledger under one arm.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his face large and off-centre, the deep blue eyes looking at the viewer with a courteous, measuring look. Cold blue-white snow light from one side. Foreground blur: fluttering ledger pages full of names and the frayed edge of an old war banner. He wears the slate-grey steward's coat.

name: 扶剑登位的那一位
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3133
who: Luitpold, the first emperor crowned without drawing the sword Daybreak, thirty-one years old: medium height, a straight back, a thin face. Glossy blue-black hair neatly cut at the nape. Gentle pale lilac eyes. Pale, slender, long-fingered hands of a man who held pens more than swords, always in white gloves, worn the whole year round. No rings over the gloves, no earrings, no glasses. A quiet, courteous, patient man who offers others a seat and stands himself, and listens until they have finished.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man of about thirty, a thin, slightly hollow-cheeked face, gentle pale lilac eyes under straight dark brows, faint bluish shadows under the eyes from sleepless nights, a straight nose, a closed, careful mouth, clean-shaven; clean pale skin.
build: medium height, a slight, narrow-shouldered build with a very straight back.
palette: blue-black, pale lilac, deep blue, white, gold
casual: His everyday court clothes: a long deep blue wool coat to the knee closing down the front with plain silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a high collar over a white shirt, dark grey trousers and black boots, the white gloves. He holds a folder of decrees against his chest, a tired, polite closed-mouth smile.
private: Alone late at night: a long white linen shirt under a dark wine-red wool house coat closing down the front, tied with a sash, the white gloves still on. He stands holding a quill pen, the head slightly bowed, tired but calm.
battle: The ceremonial armour of the sword-propping rite: a polished white-gold breastplate and pauldrons over a long deep blue coat, a white mantle on the shoulders, the white gloves; an empty sword belt with no sword in it.
battle_pose: 3) the ceremonial-armour outfit: standing very straight and still, both white-gloved hands resting empty and folded in front of him; he never draws a sword and holds no weapon.
formal: Coronation dress: a long white coat to the ankles closing down the front with gold buttons, the chest embroidered with a gold kite, the bird of prey with spread wings, a heavy deep blue mantle trimmed in white fur, a plain gold crown circlet set with small white stones, the white gloves. He stands with the hands folded in front, the face composed and pale.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his face large and off-centre, the pale lilac eyes looking at the viewer, open and tired, the mouth closed. Cold, pale dawn light from one side on his blue-black hair. Foreground blur: the gilded cross-guard of a great sword standing in stone and strips of white linen drifting. One white-gloved hand is raised near his chest.

name: 阿达尔贝特·克莱门斯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3173
who: Adalbert Clemens, head of the house of Clemens, eldest of the fourteen houses on the steps and descendant of the White Kite kings, fifty-one years old: tall, with a very straight back, a former lancer of the northern Wall gone lean with age. Silver-grey hair cut very short. Very deep ink-green eyes that watch where a person puts their hands. A single white feather pinned at his collar. A small black ebony key on a fine chain at his belt. White gloves. No rings, no earrings, no glasses. Courteous, measured, always speaking last; the angrier he is, the slower he talks.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man of fifty-one, a long, lean, composed face with fine lines at the outer eye corners and across the forehead, very deep ink-green eyes under straight silver-grey brows, a high straight nose, thin lips closed in a courteous line, clean-shaven.
build: about 183 cm, tall and lean, a very straight back and broad but spare shoulders.
palette: silver grey, deep ink green, white, black ebony, silver
casual: His house dress in the upper city: a long dark forest-green wool coat to below the knee closing down the front with silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a high collar with the white feather pinned on its left side (on the viewer's right when he faces us), a pale grey waistcoat, a white shirt, dark trousers and black riding boots, white gloves, the small ebony key on its chain at the belt. He stands with both hands folded on top of a slim black walking cane.
private: In his study at home: the gloves off, a long dark green velvet house coat closing down the front with a sash, a white shirt open at the collar, the ebony key on its chain at the sash. He stands holding a slim closed ebony box in both hands.
battle: As the old lancer of the northern Wall: plain, unadorned steel half-plate over a long white coat, the chest embroidered in silver thread with a white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings; steel gauntlets, tall boots; he grips a long cavalry lance upright in his right hand, the feet planted, the face cold and composed.
formal: Presiding over the sword-propping rite: a long white-and-silver ceremonial coat to the ankles closing down the front with silver buttons, a short white mantle, the white feather at the collar, white gloves; at his hip hangs a rune-engraved spell-gun, a slim wand-like ceremonial piece, NOT a modern firearm. He stands very straight with one hand raised as if bidding someone to place their hand.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his face large and off-centre, the ink-green eyes looking at the viewer, calm and measuring, a faint courteous smile. Cold white light falls from above and one side on his short silver hair. Foreground blur: a drifting white kite feather and the dark lacquered edge of an ebony box. He wears the forest-green coat with the white feather at the collar.

name: 黛茜
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3217
who: Daisy, a human tavern singer in the back alleys of the lower city, twenty-seven years old: medium height, about 162 cm. Soft cream-gold curly hair pinned up loosely with a single wooden pin, curls escaping around her face, a dried daisy always tucked above her left ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us). Wine-red eyes. Calluses from lute strings on her fingertips, and a quieter sword-callus in the web of her thumb. She carries an old, worn lute. No earrings, no other jewellery. Lazy, teasing and warm; she turns heavy words into light ones with a laugh.
build: about 162 cm, medium height and softly built, with nimble, callused hands.
palette: cream gold, wine red, faded blue, white linen, dried-daisy yellow
casual: Her tavern clothes: a long-sleeved white linen blouse with the sleeves pushed to the elbow and a softly open collar, a laced dark wine-red bodice, a long faded blue skirt to the ankles, a short grey apron tied over it with a washing cloth tucked into the waistband, worn brown ankle boots. She holds the old worn lute against her hip, a lazy, teasing half-smile.
private: Late after closing: a loose long-sleeved linen chemise under a knitted grey shawl, a long dark skirt, barefoot, the curls let down with the dried daisy still above her left ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us). She stands holding a chipped cup of wine, a sleepy smile.
battle: The one night she goes up on the rooftops: dark trousers tucked into boots, a fitted dark leather jerkin over the white linen blouse, a short dark hooded cloak, the curls pinned tight with the wooden pin, the dried daisy above her left ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us); she holds an old plain straight sword in her right hand, a straight double-edged blade, NOT a curved sword; the lute left behind; a low, ready stance, no smile.
formal: Singing on a festival night: a long deep wine-red wool dress with a modest square neckline edged in white lace, long fitted sleeves, a narrow belt of braided cord, a fresh daisy beside the dried one in her hair; she holds the old lute ready to play, a warm, open smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, her face large and off-centre, the wine-red eyes looking at the viewer with a lazy, knowing half-smile. Warm amber lamplight from one side on her cream-gold curls. Foreground blur: the strings and worn neck of the lute, drifting dried daisy petals and the rim of a wooden tankard. She wears the white linen blouse and wine-red bodice.

name: 百锁
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3237
who: Flip, called Hundred-Locks, a human thief of the lower city in his early forties: short and wiry, quick on his feet. Light chestnut hair pulled back into a small stubby tail. Grey-blue eyes that look first for the gaps in things. A wide, easy grin with a fine set of white teeth. On his belt a big ring of keys, one copied for every lock he has opened, each key wrapped in soft leather so they never jingle. No earrings, no rings, no glasses. A joking, showing-off air, the serious things hidden behind the jokes.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man in his early forties, a lean, mobile face with laugh lines at the eye corners, grey-blue eyes under light chestnut brows, a short straight nose, a wide grin with even white teeth, light stubble on the jaw.
build: about 165 cm, short and wiry, narrow-shouldered and light, with long nimble fingers.
palette: light chestnut, grey-blue, dark brown leather, faded green, soft tan
casual: His everyday clothes: a close-fitting dark brown leather jerkin over a long-sleeved faded green linen shirt, dark grey trousers tucked into soft-soled black boots, the leather-wrapped key ring at his left hip. He holds a tin cup of water he has just asked for at someone's door, a wide friendly grin.
private: At home in the lower city: a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt untucked, a brown wool waistcoat hanging open, rolled trousers and worn slippers, the key ring at his hip. He stands turning a leather-wrapped key over in his fingers, a sly smile.
battle: Out on a night job: a dark grey hooded short cloak over close-fitting black clothes, soft black boots, thin white gloves copied from a mansion owner's pair, the key ring at his hip bound tight with a strap. He holds a fine steel lockpick raised.
battle_pose: 3) the night-work outfit: light and poised on the balls of the feet, the shoulders loose, a sly grin, one gloved hand holding a fine steel lockpick raised; he holds no weapon.
formal: Dressed up as a gentleman to walk into the upper city: a borrowed deep blue frock coat a little too long in the sleeves, a white cravat, a grey waistcoat, white gloves, polished buckled shoes, the chestnut tail neatly tied with a black ribbon, the key ring hidden under the coat. He stands with an exaggerated, mock-noble bow, grinning.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, his face large and off-centre, the grey-blue eyes looking at the viewer with a crooked, cheerful grin. Cold blue pre-dawn light from one side, his breath faintly visible. Foreground blur: the gilded hilt of a great sword standing in stone, a folded white linen cloth drifting and leather-wrapped keys. He wears the dark brown leather jerkin.

name: 库尼贡德·格拉芬
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3257
who: Kunigunde Graffen, a human notary of the upper city and mistress of the Graffen counting-house, forty-eight years old: tall and thin, the back straight as a ruler. Iron-grey hair coiled up perfectly neat. Pale grey eyes that look at people as if checking a sum. White gloves all year round, the palm of the right glove worn thin from holding a stone. A small seal of polished white stone pinned at her collar. She carries the white notary stone, smooth and palm-sized. No earrings, no rings. Courteous, slow and cold; every sentence holds a number.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman of forty-eight, a long, narrow face with fine lines at the eye corners and beside the mouth, pale grey eyes under thin, precise brows, a straight thin nose, thin lips pressed into a polite line.
build: about 172 cm, tall and thin with a very straight back, narrow shoulders and a spare, flat figure.
palette: deep teal, iron grey, white stone, black, a little silver
casual: Her counting-house dress: a long deep teal wool dress to the floor with long fitted sleeves and a high collar, closing down the front with small covered buttons, the small white-stone seal pinned at the throat, white gloves, a narrow black belt with a small ledger hanging from a silver chatelaine. She holds the palm-sized white notary stone in her right hand.
private: At her desk at home, late: a long dark teal velvet house robe closing down the front with buttons and fitted sleeves, the iron-grey hair still neatly coiled, the white gloves still on. She stands holding an open ledger in both hands, reading it without expression.
battle: Presiding over the pressing of a contract: the deep teal dress under a long black wool notary's over-robe closing down the front, the white-stone seal at the throat, white gloves; she holds the white notary stone.
battle_pose: 3) the notary's outfit: rigid and composed, the back straight, one white-gloved hand raising the white notary stone at chest height, the other at her side; she does not fight and holds no weapon.
formal: At an upper-city spring banquet: a long deep teal silk gown with a high white lace collar and long sleeves, a short black cape, white gloves, a fine silver chain of office over the shoulders, the white-stone seal at the throat. She stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a thin, polite smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, her face large and off-centre, the pale grey eyes looking at the viewer as if checking a figure, the mouth in a thin polite line. Cold white light from one side. Foreground blur: a contract sheet with rows of red thumbprints and fine white stone dust drifting. She wears the deep teal dress, the white notary stone held in her gloved hand near her chin.

name: 穆塔兹
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3336
who: Muttaz, a flame-horn demon and high priest before the throne of the Hundred Cities' Ash. He has always looked twenty-seven or twenty-eight. About 182 cm, lean and upright. A pair of dark horns lies close along his skull and curls backward; the horn tips are scorched bone-white by white fire. Short ash-coloured hair and pale gold eyes. A thin chain is wound three times round his left wrist (on the viewer's right when he faces us), and on its end hangs a censer of black mountain-copper. Its wall is pierced as a ring of one hundred tiny city gates, white fire shows through every gate, and one small arrow hole in the wall has been patched over. No jewellery and no glasses. His manner is slow, steady and liturgical. He is calm and certain, never angry, and he remembers everything.
palette: priestly black, bone white, pale gold, ash grey, a cold white-fire glow
casual: His priest's dress: a long black robe edged with a white band, closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a high plain collar, a black sash at the waist, soft black boots. The censer hangs from the chain on his left wrist, held a little forward so the white fire glows through its hundred little gates. His right hand is raised open, palm down, as if about to judge whose eyes are steady. He stands still with a calm, measuring look.
private: Off duty in his own tent: the white-edged robe exchanged for a plain long-sleeved black wool tunic to the knee, belted, over dark trousers and soft boots, the chain still on his left wrist with the censer hanging from it. He holds a small cup of water and gazes at the censer's light, composed and unhurried.
battle: Ready to pour fire: the black white-edged robe belted tight, its long skirt slit at the sides for walking, black leather bracers over the sleeves. The censer swings out on its chain from his left hand, white fire spilling in a thin bright stream from the gates in its wall, and in his right hand he grips a plain black priest's staff. His look is flat and certain, his mouth closed.
formal: Standing before the throne: a floor-length black robe with a broad white border down the front and at the cuffs, closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a narrow white stole over both shoulders, the horn tips freshly bright. The censer hangs quiet from his left wrist, and both hands are folded before him. He stands very straight with a solemn, prayer-like stillness.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and off-centre, pale gold eyes looking down at the viewer as if lifting a tent flap to inspect a child. The censer is raised near his chin, and a cold white light from below through its tiny gates lights his jaw and horn tips, with deep ash-grey shadow on the other side. Foreground blur: drops of white fire drifting like rain and the pierced edge of the censer wall.

name: 维甘德·格伦茨
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3393
who: Wigand Grenz, human head of the Grenz house, one of the fourteen houses at the steps. He keeps the southernmost gate of the long wall and is a peerless archer, forty-nine years old in the year shown. He is tall and thin, and his right shoulder sits lower than the left (on the viewer's left when he faces us) from forty years of drawing the bow. Flaxen-gold hair is cut very short, and his ice-green eyes look at people as if measuring a distance. Three fingers of his right hand are wrapped in old deerskin, and there is an old burn scar pressed flat in his left palm. A badge of polished white stone shaped as a boundary marker is pinned at his collar. No other jewellery and no glasses. He is courteous and always smiling, and he is exact with numbers.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man of forty-nine, a narrow face with fine lines at the corners of the eyes and two faint lines beside the mouth; keen, slightly narrowed ice-green eyes; straight pale flaxen brows; a thin, pleasant, polite smile with the lips closed; short flaxen-gold hair with a little grey at the temples.
palette: flaxen gold, ice green, boundary-stone white, worn riding-coat slate blue, a little deerskin tan
casual: Keeping the gate: an old slate-blue riding coat to mid-thigh, closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the white-stone boundary badge at the collar, a pale linen shirt, a brown leather belt, grey breeches and tall riding boots. Three fingers of his right hand are wrapped in deerskin. He holds the gate ledger open in his left hand and a quill in his right, ready to write a name and a toll, smiling politely.
private: At home in the gatehouse: no coat, a loose pale linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm, a dark waistcoat left unbuttoned, grey breeches and soft house boots, the deerskin still on his fingers. He holds a single fletched arrow up to eye level and sights down the shaft to check that it is straight, wearing a small contented smile.
battle: Leading the boundary bowmen: a fitted dark slate-blue archer's coat over a light leather breastplate, the white-stone badge at the collar, a leather bracer on the left forearm, a quiver of plain smooth-shafted arrows at his right hip. He holds a tall pale longbow half drawn with three arrows on the string at once, the deerskin-wrapped fingers on the string, and his ice-green eyes are fixed on a far target.
formal: As one of the fourteen houses at the steps: a long slate-blue coat with silver buttons and a high collar, the white-stone boundary badge pinned at the throat, white gloves on both hands, a white sash, and a rune-engraved spell-gun hanging at his left hip as a status piece, slim and wand-like, NOT a firearm with a trigger. He stands straight, one hand on the sash, wearing an easy courteous smile.
art: A tilted portrait from the gatehouse height, the face large, the ice-green eyes measuring the viewer, a polite smile. Cold white light comes from one side, as if from the white boundary stone over the gate, and soft reed-green shadow falls on the other. Foreground blur: the fletching of an arrow and a long trailing thread of white light curving away, the arrow that turns in flight.

name: 索伦德
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3059
who: Sorend, a northern human from the Frost Hall city whom the travellers only call the guide. He is a legend who won against the King of the Frost Spirits, and he has looked about forty ever since. He is tall and lean with long limbs. His grey-gold hair is cut short, and his short beard of the same grey-gold is rimed with frost. Ice-blue eyes look at people slowly. He wears an old hide coat with no crest or emblem of any kind. He carries no sword. He carries a thin, dry, white, leafless branch, and in later years the light, brittle white wooden bow made from it, with a flake of rough-edged true silver set into the bow arm. No jewellery and no glasses. He speaks little and plainly, and he is patient, weathered and unshowy.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, weathered man of about forty, faint lines at the eyes and across the brow, calm half-lowered ice-blue eyes that look slowly; a short trimmed grey-gold beard and moustache with white frost caught in it; a straight nose; a quiet, closed mouth; cheeks and nose tip reddened by wind.
palette: frost white, grey gold, ice blue, worn hide brown-grey, a glint of raw silver
casual: Leading the long walk south: an old knee-length hide coat with no emblem, the fur turned inside and the outside scraped pale, belted with a plain leather strap, wool leggings, hide boots bound with thongs, a grey wool scarf at the neck. In his right hand he holds the dry white leafless branch like a walking stick. He looks back over his shoulder toward the end of the line with a steady, patient face.
private: By the campfire at the tail of the line: the hide coat open over a plain undyed wool tunic, the scarf loosened, leggings and boots. He holds a wooden bowl of broth in both hands and offers it forward, as if saying eat first, with a quiet, plain face.
battle: Out hunting on the snow line: the emblemless hide coat belted tight, a hood of grey wool, leather bracers, a quiver of arrows across his back. He holds the light, brittle white wooden bow with the flake of rough true silver in its arm, an arrow nocked and half drawn, standing very still with the ice-blue eyes fixed on the distance.
formal: The guide as the old north would honour him: a faded white long coat over the hide tunic, no emblem anywhere, a grey wool mantle pinned at one shoulder with a plain iron pin, clean hide boots. He stands with the white branch held upright before him in both hands, grave and unadorned.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large, ice-blue eyes turned to the viewer with a small, quiet smile of something finally made clear. Pale green aurora light falls low from above one side, and cold snow-blue shadow lies on the other. Foreground blur: drifting snow, glittering ice splinters, and the pale tip of the dry white branch.

name: 盖尔蒙
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3095
who: Gearmon, once the spearman of the king of the Frost Hall city, now known in a valley below the snow line only as the stranger. He is a human legend who has looked about forty ever since. He is tall with thick, heavy shoulders. He has short glossy black hair with a cold blue sheen and dark copper-orange eyes. An old pale scar runs across the left side of his neck (on the viewer's right when he faces us). He carries one short mountain-copper hunting javelin, weighted toward the butt. He wears no crest and no jewellery, and no glasses. He is silent, unexplaining and immovable, worn down by thirty years of pursuit.
palette: blue-black, dull copper orange, worn wolf-grey, snow white, a line of copper light
casual: A stranger in the valley: a worn wolf-skin coat worn fur inside, the outside tanned pale, belted with a rope, dark wool trousers, hide boots wrapped with thongs, the collar open enough to show the scar on the left side of his neck. In his right hand he holds the short mountain-copper hunting javelin low at his side. He stands heavy and still with a closed, tired face.
private: Alone in a hut in the valley: a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, a sheepskin vest, dark wool trousers and old boots. He holds a whetstone in one hand and turns the copper javelin head toward the light with the other, looking at it without expression.
battle: On the beast's trail: the wolf-skin coat belted tight over a quilted wool jerkin, leather bracers, a hood thrown back, mud on the boots. He holds the short mountain-copper javelin raised back over his right shoulder, ready to throw, the body coiled, and a faint copper glow runs down the shaft. His eyes are hard and his mouth is closed.
formal: The old king's spearman he no longer wants to be: a faded white long coat of the king's hall, closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, pale frost-blue trim at the hem and cuffs, a plain dark belt, polished boots, and no weapon at all. He stands straight with the hands empty at his sides and a closed, unreadable face.
art: A tilted portrait, the face large and turned half away, copper-orange eyes looking past the viewer. One hard beam of copper light runs along the javelin shaft beside his face from one side, and grey-blue dusk lies on the other. Foreground blur: bending grass blades flattened forward and flying stone chips from a split rock.

name: 英薇·桦火
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:待查
who: Ingvi Birchfire, a northern human woman of the mercenary company Unquenched Campfire. She is a legend whose face has stayed twenty-six ever since. About 169 cm, sturdy and well-balanced, with long fingers and warm hands. Her bright red-orange hair is pulled up into a high braid. She has teal-green eyes and a light dusting of freckles on either side of the bridge of her nose. She wears a short capelet pieced together from old scraps of fur, and a copper ladle hangs at her belt beneath it. She carries a small iron fire basin. No jewellery and no glasses. She is quick-tongued and teasing with the young, kind and attentive with the old, and she always checks people's shoes.
build: 169 cm, sturdy and well-balanced: firm shoulders and back, a D-cup, a narrow waist and full rounded hips.
palette: red-orange flame, teal green, patched fur browns, northern wool red, copper
casual: On the snow road with the company: a short capelet pieced from old fur scraps over a fitted dark wool jacket, closing down the front with toggles, fitted sleeves, a small campfire badge embroidered on the left chest, a knee-length northern red wool skirt over thick wool leggings, sturdy fur-trimmed boots she stitched herself, the copper ladle hanging from her belt under the capelet. She holds a half-finished new boot and a needle with thread, smiling as if about to tease someone.
private: Sitting up late for the others: a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed wool dress to the shins, a red knitted shawl, thick socks and soft boots, the braid let down over one shoulder. She holds a wooden shoe last in her lap with one hand and a needle in the other, her face soft and listening.
battle: Carrying fire across the snow line: the fur capelet tied tight, the wool jacket buttoned, leather bracers, the red skirt kilted up over leggings, the copper ladle at her belt. She holds the small iron fire basin forward in both hands, warm flame rising from it and glowing along her arms up to the shoulders, and she wears a determined, unafraid face.
formal: At a company rite in the southern village: a long white wool coat over the red skirt, the front embroidered with a sprig of birch in red and orange thread, a clean fur collar, the high braid tied with new red cord, polished boots, the copper ladle hung at the belt. She stands with hands folded and a warm, steady smile.
art: A tilted portrait, the face large, teal-green eyes looking straight at the viewer with a bright grin, freckles catching the light. Warm red-gold firelight comes from below and one side out of the fire basin she cradles, with cold snow-blue on the other side. Foreground blur: sparks, swirling snow, and a few fresh green grass blades pushing through.

name: 绮洛
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:待查
who: Kiro, a night-wing demon from the scattered households of the grey plain. She gives no family name. She is a legend whose face has stayed twenty-two or twenty-three. About 163 cm, light-backed with broad shoulder blades. She has short smoke-purple hair and honey-yellow eyes. Two small horns curve outward from her head. Large bat-like wings grow from her back, with grey-purple membranes and NO feathers anywhere, and faint gold veins show in the membranes in light. A single white clay bead hangs from her right ear (on the viewer's left when she faces us). She goes barefoot. No other jewellery and no glasses. She is teasing, full of small schemes, gentle with frightened people, and loves the open sky.
build: 163 cm, light and agile: broad shoulder blades and a light back, a C-cup, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: smoke purple, honey yellow, grey-purple wing membrane with gold veins, old leather brown, clay white
casual: Everyday in the camp under the stone terrace: a fitted old leather vest belted tight at the waist, with two open slits down the back for the wings, over a short-sleeved faded canvas shirt, knee-length canvas trousers, barefoot, the single white clay bead at her right ear. She holds a handful of red flowers up in one hand, about to crush them to show a child the colour of rose clouds, and grins.
private: Resting after mending tents: a loose long-sleeved grey canvas shirt with open slits in the back for the wings, the sleeves tied at the wrist with thin cords, soft canvas trousers to the ankle, barefoot. She stands with her wings folded and her arms stretched up over her head, looking upward with a lazy, happy face.
battle: Bearing the weight: the leather vest belted tight with the back slits open, leather wraps on the forearms, canvas trousers bound at the knee, barefoot. Her wings are spread wide, the grey-purple membranes lit with gold veins, and she has no weapon. Both arms are raised overhead with the palms up as if holding something enormous, her jaw set.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and straining, the feet planted wide and bare, both arms raised overhead with the palms up as if holding up a great weight, the bat-like wings spread wide with glowing gold veins, no weapon, a fierce, set face with the mouth closed.
formal: Her one good dress for a camp wedding: a clean long smoke-grey canvas dress with long fitted sleeves, two open slits down the back for the wings, a woven honey-yellow sash at the waist, barefoot, the white clay bead at her right ear, a red flower tucked behind her left horn. She stands with the wings folded and both hands behind her back, smiling.
art: A tilted portrait, the face large and off-centre, honey-yellow eyes looking up past the viewer at the sky with a delighted smile, one hand half-hiding the corner of her mouth. Warm gold light shines through her outspread wing membrane from behind one side, and soft dusky violet lies on the other. Foreground blur: drifting grey ash, a red petal, and a white clay bead swinging close to the lens.

name: 达乌德
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_二_长夜的年月.md:3300
who: Daud, who answers only to the name Grey Flag, a man of the outer camps of the demon west. He is a legend who looks thirty-five or thirty-six. He is tall and lean with broad shoulders. A strip of grey cloth is wound around his head and hides his temples, and nothing beneath it is shown. Short rough deep wine-red hair shows under the cloth, and he has dark sea-blue eyes. He wears a coarse grey outer-camp coat whose left sleeve is torn off short (on the viewer's right when he faces us). His bow is of mountain copper, and the torn strip of grey sleeve is nailed fast along its upper arm. No jewellery and no glasses. He speaks in short sentences, eats from the same pot as everyone else, and never lets anyone kneel.
palette: coarse ash grey, deep wine red, dark sea blue, mountain-copper bronze, a white streak of arrow light
casual: Walking into a freed town: a long coarse grey cloth coat in the outer-camp style, belted with a cord, the left sleeve torn short above the elbow and the arm bare under it, a grey linen shirt, dark trousers, worn boots, the grey cloth bound round his head. He holds the mountain-copper bow unstrung at his side in his right hand, its nailed grey strip hanging from the arm, with a calm, plain face.
private: Eating with the camp folk: the grey coat off, a plain grey linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, dark trousers and boots, the grey cloth still round his head. He holds a shared wooden bowl in one hand and a spoon in the other, standing easily with a quiet, tired face.
battle: Holding the pass: the grey coat belted tight, the left sleeve torn short, a leather bracer on the left forearm, a full quiver at his right hip. He draws the mountain-copper bow to full length, the nailed grey strip snapping from its arm, and the arrow on the string glows white. His eyes are steady and his mouth is closed.
formal: The plainest best he has, for nailing up the grey cloth over a town gate: the same coarse grey coat brushed clean and closed down the front with wooden buttons, the torn left sleeve left as it is, a fresh grey head cloth, a length of grey banner cloth over his right shoulder, the strung copper bow held upright. He stands straight with an unsmiling, open face.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and half hidden behind the drawn bow, dark sea-blue eyes sighting past the viewer. A blinding white line of arrow light comes from one side, and deep ember red lies on the other. Foreground blur: the nailed grey cloth strip whipping across the frame, flying embers, and flakes of cooled black stone.
